strings_catalog.title: GEWA: Strings catalog with Student / Advanced / Professional filters
strings_catalog.scope: Official GEWA product catalog exposes requirement filters and serial violin/cello lines. Filter taxonomy belongs to manufacturer; it is not a European certification standard.

german_engineered.title: GEWA: German Engineered bowed-instrument series
german_engineered.scope: Official catalog lists Allegro, Ideale, Maestro and related lines inside GEWA German Engineered range.

cello_catalog.title: GEWA: Cello catalog
cello_catalog.scope: Official cello catalog lists Allegro from 1/16 through 7/8 and higher series. Size availability is catalog evidence, not teacher endorsement.

distinctions: GEWA series hierarchy is a manufacturer taxonomy, not a mandatory school ranking.
Fractional size and series tier remain independent.
Ready-to-play status must be verified on each rental specimen.
Public page does not confirm ONTOS.RENT stock.
